source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 5 (questions: PDF pages 22–24, solutions: PDF pages 115–117). Five diagrams, three questions on each; every key answer was checked by reading which shapes each number lies in.

questions.prompt: The total number of cricket players who are also badminton players.
questions.rule: Cricket players are inside the triangle and badminton players inside the rectangle. Add every number inside both shapes.
questions.working: Inside the triangle and the rectangle: 12 + 10 = 22

questions.prompt: The total number of volleyball players who are both badminton players and cricket players.
questions.rule: Volleyball is the circle, badminton the rectangle and cricket the triangle. Take the middle part, inside all three shapes.
questions.working: Inside the circle, the rectangle and the triangle: 10

options.C: Volleyball players who are not cricket players
options.D: Volleyball players who are not badminton players

questions.rule: 9 is inside the circle (volleyball) but outside the rectangle and the triangle, so it stands for people who play volleyball and nothing else.
questions.working: Volleyball players: 9 + 6 + 10 + 5. Not cricket: 9 + 5. Not badminton: 9 + 6. Only volleyball: 9

questions.prompt: The total number of students who study English.
questions.rule: English is the rectangle. Add every number inside it, including the parts it shares with the circle and the oval.

questions.prompt: Which number represents the students who study only English?
questions.rule: Only English: inside the rectangle but outside the circle (Kannada) and the oval (Hindi).
questions.working: The bottom part of the rectangle: 7

questions.prompt: Which number represents the students who study all three subjects?
questions.rule: All three: the part inside the circle, the rectangle and the oval.

questions.prompt: The total number of doctors is:
questions.rule: Doctors are the rectangle. Add every number inside it, including the parts it shares with the circle and the triangle.

questions.prompt: The number of people who are dancers only.
questions.rule: Dancers only: inside the circle but outside the triangle (swimmers) and the rectangle (doctors).
questions.working: The top-left part of the circle: 9

questions.prompt: The total number of dancers who are not doctors.
questions.rule: Dancers who are not doctors: every part of the circle that is outside the rectangle, whether or not it is in the triangle.

questions.prompt: The total number of people who drink tea, coffee and milk.
questions.rule: Tea is the triangle, coffee the circle and milk the rectangle. Take the part inside all three shapes.
questions.working: Inside the triangle, the circle and the rectangle: 5

questions.prompt: The total number of people who drink both tea and coffee.
questions.rule: Add every number inside both the triangle (tea) and the circle (coffee), including the part that is also in the rectangle (milk).
questions.working: Inside the triangle and the circle: 5 + 7 = 12

questions.prompt: The total number of people who drink only coffee.
questions.rule: Only coffee: the parts of the circle outside both the triangle and the rectangle. There are two such parts, above and below the rectangle.
questions.working: The circle outside the triangle and the rectangle: 15 + 2 = 17

questions.prompt: The number of people who support all three teams: Sunrisers, CSK and MI.
questions.rule: Sunrisers is the six-sided shape, CSK the circle and MI the rectangle. Take the part inside all three.
questions.working: Inside the six-sided shape, the circle and the rectangle: 25

questions.prompt: The number of people who support only the CSK team.
questions.rule: Only CSK: the part of the circle outside every other shape.
questions.working: The top-left part of the circle: 32

questions.prompt: The total number of people who support both Sunrisers and MI.
questions.rule: Add every number inside both the six-sided shape (Sunrisers) and the rectangle (MI), including the parts also in the circle (CSK) or the triangle (RCB).
questions.working: Inside the six-sided shape and the rectangle: 25 + 31 + 8 = 64
